name: Best-First Octree Traversal with Screen-Space LOD
definition: A traversal algorithm that walks the octree best-first, expanding the node that projects largest on screen, culling outside the frustum, and refining nodes only while they meet size and budget constraints.
summary: Best-First Octree Traversal with Screen-Space LOD renders sparse volumes by prioritizing nodes that project largest on screen, dynamically adjusting detail to fit a strict rendering budget.
